To resolve the downstream CI contract failures (`analytics-ingest` requiring `placedAt` and `billing-service` requiring `totalCents`) while adopting the unified naming convention (`createdAt` and `amountCents`), [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30) now includes both the new field names and the legacy aliases for backward compatibility.

### Summary of Changes:
- **[`src/core/events.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/src/core/events.ts)**:
  - Updated [`OrderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/src/core/events.ts#L7-L30) interface to include both `createdAt` and `placedAt`, as well as `amountCents` and `totalCents`.
  - Updated the [`orderPlaced`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/src/core/events.ts#L46-L67) event builder to populate both sets of fields from the order.
- **[`test/app.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/test/app.test.ts)** and **[`test/adapters.test.ts`](file:///C:/avg/w1/r/test/adapters.test.ts)**:
  - Updated tests to assert both new (`createdAt`, `amountCents`) and legacy (`placedAt`, `totalCents`) fields on emitted events.
